data.narrative:
Quobly is a seed-stage quantum computing company founded by Maud Vinet, Tristan Meunier, and François Perruchot. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ, though the private cohort spans multiple development stages and valuation tiers.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The quantum computing universe contains only 8 private companies, but filtering for same-stage peers, adjacent-stage peers, or similar valuation tiers yields fewer than three datapoints in any narrow category. Applying an all-sector median would not produce a defensible result given the heterogeneity in stage, technology approach, and capital intensity across the comp set. No triangulated valuation range can be derived from the available quantitative data.

A meaningful valuation for Quobly at seed stage would require either: expansion of the comparable set to adjacent sectors (e.g., deep tech infrastructure), deployment of venture capital method analysis using explicit revenue or milestone assumptions, or access to recent seed-round pricing from the private peer set. The current dataset supports sector positioning only—not quantitative valuation.
